A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ADSeeker, MulA, and SEEK-M&V, with readable text, equations, figures, and tables supporting comparison. All pages were inspected. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix, although v1 Section 3.1 references one; no appendix deletion can therefore be established.

before.justification: v1 reports original anomaly-detection and reasoning results, module and prompt ablations, and memory/time measurements in Tables 2–6 and Figure 5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments in Tables 1–5 and adds comparative reasoning plots and qualitative localization outputs in Figures 1 and 6.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 retain the same Q2K RAG retrieval and KDE sampling, AD Expert fusion, HSP optimization, and MulA-based prompt clustering. The specified Qwen2.5-VL and CLIP architecture is unchanged; replacing LLM labels with VLM does not establish a model revision.

E1.justification: MulA, MMAD, and the seven tabulated ZSAD benchmarks are retained. v2 Figure 6(B) newly documents qualitative localization in unseen scenarios, including endoscopic and skin-lesion images beyond v1's documented brain-imaging examples. Their dataset sources are unspecified.

E2.justification: v2 Figure 1 adds comparisons against Anomaly-GPT, Qwen-VL-Chat, and LLaVA-1.5, alongside new subtask comparisons with AnomalyR1 on DS-MVTec and VisA. Comparator membership in the matched numerical tables remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported MVTec/VisA training arrangement, disabled retrieval for ZSAD evaluation, AUROC metric, MMAD one-shot/template procedure, model scales, and LoRA epoch settings are retained. The added figures do not document a distinct or revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: v2 Figure 6(B) adds localization heatmaps illustrating type-level features across industrial and unseen examples. The existing similarity matrix and prompt ablation move from v1 Figure 5 to v2 Figure 6(A); module ablations, LoRA analysis, and efficiency measurements are retained.

E5.justification: Memory and inference time retain the same mean±SD reporting in v1 Table 6 and v2 Table 5. Neither version supplies additional run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: v2 adds the task-wise comparative outcomes in Figure 1 and localization outputs in Figure 6(B). All matched quantitative tables and prompt-ablation curves retain their results, including 94.0 average ZSAD AUROC and 69.90 MMAD accuracy for Qwen2.5-VL-7B under Seek-Setting.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(9), including the similarity definitions, Gaussian-mixture/KDE expressions, sparse updates, and optimization objective, are mathematically unchanged. No new formal assumptions, propositions, or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal contributions are retained. The conclusion narrows 'without additional training' to 'without large-scale training.' The new Figure 1 caption also explicitly claims superiority over other IAD models on defect analysis and localization.

C2.justification: Section 5.4 adds an interpretation linking the new localization examples and AUROC results to general-feature extraction as the basis of zero-shot performance. Existing interpretations concerning retrieval, complementary prompts, overfitting, and restricted knowledge-base coverage otherwise remain.

D1.justification: Backbone specifications, CLIP resolution, dataset augmentation, the 43K instruction-data description, and LoRA budgets are retained. v2 promises experimental settings and training parameters but supplies no additional hyperparameter, hardware, or code/data access information.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for already evaluated VLM-R1, AnomalyR1, LoRA, dataset sources, and several industrial methods, while pruning references including unrelated LaTeX and networking entries. The main related-work arguments and positioning relative to existing anomaly-detection approaches remain substantially the same.

P1.justification: v2 revises the title and author block, edits introduction and dataset paragraphs, expands captions, shortens the conclusion, and adds acknowledgements. The main section sequence and most technical exposition are retained.

P2.justification: The paper switches from one-column to two-column layout and substantially reorganizes its displays. v1 Table 1 becomes a bar chart within v2 Figure 3; knowledge-document examples are replaced by defect illustrations; a radar comparison is added; and the existing prompt analysis is combined with new heatmaps. Result tables are relocated and restyled.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves the paper by qualifying its overbroad training-free conclusion, making localization behavior inspectable through additional examples, and removing unrelated bibliography entries. These gains are limited: the core quantitative evidence and reproducibility details remain unchanged, the new radar charts lack numeric scales and specified settings, and removing the SEEK-M&V examples weakens illustration of a central resource.
